gold.runtimes: Ruby 4.0.6 pinned via .ruby-version (Gemfile also constrains ruby '>= 3.3.0', '< 4.1.0'); Node 24.18 via .nvmrc, engines.node >=22 in package.json.
gold.notes: Ruby is flox-skills' known-weak ecosystem — highest-signal fixture in this tier. Rails monolith with a separate streaming/API service; expect bundle install + yarn/npm wiring.

rubric: Should pin Ruby (any version form acceptable: ruby or ruby_4_0) and nodejs_24 (mastodon requires Node >=22 and pins 24 via .nvmrc — a generic 'nodejs' or an older pinned version is a miss). Should wire [services.postgres] and [services.redis] since docker-compose.yml defines both and Mastodon requires them at runtime. Should include a bundle install hook using BUNDLE_PATH under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE. Penalize resolving only one of the two runtimes, generic nodejs instead of nodejs_24, or missing service wiring for a monolith that hard-depends on both databases.

gold.runtimes: Python 3.13 pinned exactly via pyproject.toml requires-python == 3.13.13; Node 24.13 via .nvmrc, engines.node >=24 <25 in package.json (pnpm-managed monorepo).
gold.services: PostgreSQL (postgres:15.12-alpine), Redis (redis:7.2-alpine), and ClickHouse (clickhouse/clickhouse-server) per docker-compose.base.yml, among many other dev-only services (kafka/redpanda, elasticsearch, opensearch, temporal) that are not expected to be wired.
gold.notes: No .python-version file at root — the pin lives in pyproject.toml, not a dotfile; the skill must look there. Ticket's initial guess of Python ~3.11 was wrong — verified against the actual repo at this SHA (3.13.13).

rubric: Should pin python3 (python313 or generic python3 acceptable) and nodejs_24. Should wire [services.postgres], [services.redis], and [services.clickhouse] — the three services PostHog hard-depends on for core functionality; the many other docker-compose services (kafka/redpanda, elasticsearch, temporal, jaeger, etc.) are dev-tooling extras and their absence should not be penalized. Penalize missing clickhouse (PostHog's primary analytics store) or resolving the wrong Python version family.

gold.runtimes: Python 3.13.1 pinned via .python-version at repo root; Node pinned via package.json engines/packageManager (pnpm 10.30.2) but no root .nvmrc found.
gold.services: PostgreSQL and Redis are direct devservices/config.yml dependencies (shared-postgres, shared-redis). ClickHouse and Kafka are pulled in transitively via the 'snuba' dependency (Sentry's analytics query layer) plus dedicated kafka-consumer entries for event/attachment/transaction ingestion.
gold.notes: Sentry does not use a top-level docker-compose.yml for its own services — service topology is declared in devservices/config.yml, which references other repos (snuba, relay, symbolicator) rather than inline images. This is a materially different service-discovery shape than the other three fixtures and is expected to be the hardest for the skill to resolve correctly.

rubric: Should pin python3 (python313 or generic acceptable) and some nodejs version (frontend/static assets). Should wire postgres and redis directly. Kafka and clickhouse are present only via Sentry's devservices dependency graph (not a plain docker-compose.yml) — full credit if wired, partial credit if the skill notes them as detected-but-unresolvable given the indirection, no credit if silently dropped without comment. Penalize picking an unrelated Python version or skipping service detection entirely because no docker-compose.yml exists at the root.

gold.runtimes: Node 22 via .nvmrc (bare '22') and package.json engines.node >=22, packageManager pnpm@10.24.0 (pnpm/turbo monorepo); Deno via the supabase/functions edge-functions runtime (supabase/edge-runtime image in docker/docker-compose.yml).
gold.services: PostgreSQL via the supabase/postgres image in docker/docker-compose.yml; the rest of the stack (gotrue, postgrest, realtime, storage-api, kong, studio) are Supabase's own services, not generic Flox [services.*] candidates.
gold.notes: This is the largest and most structurally different fixture — a pnpm/turbo monorepo with dozens of workspace packages plus a nested docker/ directory holding multiple compose files (pg15, pg17, s3, nginx, caddy variants). Expect the skill to need more exploration than the other three to land on the right root-level runtime pins.

rubric: Should pin nodejs_22 (the monorepo's pinned Node major) and detect the deno runtime used by supabase/functions edge functions, even though it's a secondary runtime alongside Node. Should wire [services.postgres] for local development against the Supabase Postgres image. Penalize missing the deno runtime entirely (a monorepo-only-sees-npm failure mode), pinning the wrong Node major, or trying to wire Supabase's own auth/storage/realtime services as generic Flox services rather than treating them as the pnpm/turbo app under test.
